capabilities: Add a right-click context menu item on folders in the navigation panel
Concatenate all Markdown files in the selected folder and copy to clipboard
Trigger recursive copy via a hotkey using the active file's parent folder
disambiguation: It does not copy or move files within the vault; it copies their concatenated text content to the clipboard.
extras: The hotkey trigger (default unbound) operates on the active file's parent folder; the README states the tool is meant for pasting context into LLMs like Claude Artifacts or ChatGPT.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to grab the combined contents of every Markdown file in a folder at once, which is tedious to do manually before pasting into an LLM chat.
summary: Folder-level copy utility that concatenates all Markdown files in a folder and puts the result on the clipboard.
